title: CapabilitySchema
description: What a hardware type can do: its channels. Registered with the HW type (manufacturer API) and, optionally, reported by the device in its claim message.

CapabilityKey.description: Catalogue capability. Actuators: switch, dimmer, rgb_light, color_temp, cover, thermostat, valve, lock. Sensors: temperature, humidity, motion, contact, water_leak, smoke, co2, illuminance, power_meter (W), energy (kWh), battery, button, voltage (V), current (A), volume (m³, water or gas meters).

CustomCapability.description: Manufacturer-specific capability; always prefixed with 'x_'. The app shows it as a generic value.

enum.description: Allowed string values, e.g. cover: open, closed, stopped.

events.description: Event types this channel emits, e.g. button: single, double, long.

report_interval_s.description: Expected maximum gap between telemetry reports.
